newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH PRIME MINISTER KOK MAY VISIT AUSTRALIA.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH PRIME MINISTER KOK MAY VISIT AUSTRALIA.

text.p: Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok and Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo are expected to visit Australia at the end of this year, Australian Foreign Affairs Minister Alexander Downer said on Monday.
He said their visit would coincide with the opening of the Rembrandt art exhibition in the Australian national capital of Canberra.
It follows the visit by heir to the Dutch throne, Crown Prince Willem-Alexander, to Western Australia last year.
On his first visit to the Netherlands as Foreign Affairs Minister, Downer said Australia was committed to strengthening its relationship with the Netherlands.

"The visit, which we are confident will occur, of the Dutch Prime Minister and Foreign Minister to Australia at the end of the year to coincide with the opening of the Rembrandt exhibition in Canberra, will be a very important moment in the relationship," Downer told reporters.
He was speaking after holding talks with Van Mierlo on a range of issues including trade and human rights.
